senses.gloss: लोमन् ló-man, n. [later form of roman] hair 🞄of the body (of men and animals, gnly. excluding 🞄hair of the head, beard, mane, or tail).
लोमश loma-śá, a. hairy, woolly, shaggy.

लोमहर्ष loma-harṣa, m. bristling of the 🞄hair, horripilation;
 -harṣaṇa, a. causing a 🞄thrill (of joy or horror).
